about: 방법 버전마다 무엇을, 왜, 언제 바꿨는지와 사전 등록 여부, 결과를 본 뒤의 결정인지, 점수 영향(종 수)을 적은 원장. python scripts/build_method_changelog.py 가 저장소의 설정·기록·보관본으로 만든다. 손으로 고치지 않는다.
timing_rule: 결정이 그 결정으로 바뀌는 값이나 채워지는 칸을 본 뒤였는지를 기록대로 적는다. 기록이 '본 뒤'라고 적었거나, 특정 종·항목을 놓고 내린 개별 판단이거나, 이미 공개한 결과가 있는 규칙으로 되돌린 경우는 '결과 확인 후'. 기록이 값을 보기 전에 정했다고 밝힌 경우만 '결과 확인 전'. 순서를 적은 기록이 없으면 '미확인'. 규칙과 판단 없이 고정 규칙 안에서 근거·표시·기록만 바뀐 버전은 '규칙 변경 없음'.
score_impact_rule: 직전 공개 버전의 보관본과 비교해 네 지표 중 하나라도 값이 바뀐 종의 수. 보관본이 없는 버전은 null(미확인).

entries.changes_from: verified-pilot-2.2 (2026-09-27). Adopts the research cross-origin potency rule (config/verified-indices-research-xo-potency.json, research/verified-indices/xo-potency-research-2026-09-27.md) as the public definition, with the same values: in the peptide stratum, a synthetic peptide with the same sequence measured by another paper from another origin (same target, endpoint, HHL substrate, uM, value in text) counts as an independent DOI for the single/multiple DOI factor and the BBVI independence check, when its pIC50 is within max_pIC50_gap of the species value. It never changes the species value (pIC50 stays the median of origin-species rows), never creates an item or a species row, and is not an origin claim. Only effect today: oyster (836033) LQP, Do et al. 2012 (origin) + Miyoshi et al. 1991 (synthetic LQP 2.0 uM, alpha-zein) -> MBPI 72.2 -> 96.3, BBVI withheld -> 80.9. A species without a national category whose IUCN search found no assessment, or whose assessment is DD, is labelled priority_survey with that reason (figure: 우선 조사 대상). entries.changes_from: verified-pilot-3.17 (2026-10-02). New MBPI stratum for antibacterial activity, the input the proposal names beside the ACE one: a fixed DBAASP cohort per target bacterium (MIC, broth media, single clean numeric value; research/verified-indices/amp-cohorts-dbaasp-2026-10-02.json, built by scripts/build_amp_cohorts.py), pMIC = 6 - log10(MIC uM), percentile inside that cohort, minimum cohort 30 and the same single/multiple-DOI factors and max aggregation as the peptide stratum. A MIC is never ranked against an ACE IC50: each stratum keeps its own cohort. Origin rows come from the original paper, never from the database (DBAASP records neither the tested material nor its synthesis): a chemically synthetic or sequence-confirmed purified single peptide whose sequence comes from the species' own gene or tissue, with a numeric MIC by broth microdilution. MEC, inhibition zones, recombinant proteins and censored values are excluded. 피조개 (AI-hemocidin 1 and 2, Li 2017) and 조피볼락 (TS40, Zhang 2022) gain an MBPI; both rest on one paper each, so both are reference values and BBVI stays withheld. entries.changes_from: verified-4.1 (2026-10-04).
